# My AI Agent Army

> The AI Agent Factory by Eye To Ad Media (headquartered in Denver, Colorado; building for businesses since 2012). Businesses and individuals order custom AI agents, from 1 to 100, each built to do one job well, with human approval on sensitive actions.

Key facts:
- Tagline: Your success is the mission. Order one agent or hundreds; franchises can run thousands of copies of one agent.
- Lane 1, ready-made (tested) agents: own a Scout from $1,500, Specialist from $3,500, Commander from $7,500; or Subscribe-to-Own from $149, $299 or $599 per agent per month plus a one-time setup of $500, $1,000 or $1,500, Care included, 2-4 year term with a buyout option. Optional Agent Care from $99/mo per agent.
- Lane 2, custom-built agents: single workflow from $4,000, multi-step $7,500-$15,000, custom multi-agent armies from $15,000; Care from 5% of the build per month.
- Ownership: clients own their agent's setup, their data and a permanent license to run it; custom code written for a client is theirs; the company keeps its general engine and templates and never reuses client data.
- Agent Blueprint (discovery and written plan): $750, credited toward the build within 60 days. Development is quoted; deployment is scoped after the Blueprint.
- Help levels: Done-For-You, Co-Pilot, Handoff. Usage costs (AI model, phone minutes, software) billed at cost or on the client's accounts.
- Built and tested now: 17 ready-made agents run today with automated tests (Daily Briefing, Speed-to-Lead Responder, Review Request, Customer Reactivation, Invoice Reminder, P&L Builder, Spend Leak Finder, Renewal Sentinel, Google Business Profile, Content Repurposer, Meeting to Actions, Desktop Organizer, Site Health, Agent-Ready Auditor, AI Visibility, Listing Consistency, Commander). Real sample output: https://www.myaiagentarmy.com/see-them-work/
- Contact: 1-800-481-8638, sales@eyetoad.com, 1001 Bannock St #660, Denver, CO 80204.
